hypotheses.title: Fundamental Operating Income Yield & Intraday VWAP Dislocation Super Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Combines a slow fundamental cashflow anchor (operating_income / close, 180d lookback, turnover ~8%) with the high-Sharpe 5-day VWAP intraday catalyst (which delivered Sharpe 1.47 in Batch 65). The fundamental anchor cuts turnover in half while the VWAP dislocation generates high information coefficient, targeting Sharpe >= 1.80 and Fitness >= 1.50.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high operating income firms suffer persistent intraday selling pressure.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(operating_income, 60) / close, 180), subindustry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((vwap - close) / close, 5), subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Operating Income Yield Anchor & 5-Day VWAP Catalyst

hypotheses.title: Book-to-Price Value Dislocation & Intraday VWAP Dislocation Super Alpha
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Pairs Fama-French Book-to-Price value (bookvalue_ps / close, 252d lookback) with the 5-day VWAP order flow catalyst. Deep value stocks suffering short-term intraday market-maker selling experience sharp mean-reverting rebounds with zero portfolio self-correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high book-to-price stocks fail to rebound from VWAP discounts.

candidates.expression: 0.60 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_backfill(bookvalue_ps, 60) / close, 252), subindustry) + 0.40 * group_rank(ts_decay_linear((vwap - close) / close, 5), subindustry)
candidates.rationale: Book Value Yield Anchor & 5-Day VWAP Catalyst

hypotheses.title: 3-Year LEAP Market-Neutral Volatility Risk Premia (Linear Concentration Fix)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Direct fix for Batch 60 Alpha 2 which passed 6 gates with Sharpe 1.48, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.71, and Fitness 1.16. By replacing signed_power with pure linear group_rank across Market scope, instrument weights remain perfectly uniform, eliminating the weight concentration failure while preserving superior risk premia.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if 3-year implied volatility chronically underprices realized multi-year equity volatility.

candidates.rationale: 1080-Day LEAP Market Neutral Premia with Uniform Linear Weights
